resources.string: Android denied this app some thermal zones. The root snapshot may read them.
Read by zthermal %1$s from /sys/class/thermal. Read only: nothing is written.
zthermal (Zairenkai-ThermalTools) is Apache-2.0. Its statically linked Rust crates are MIT OR Apache-2.0, plus foldhash (Zlib), memchr (Unlicense OR MIT), generic-array and zmij (MIT).

One root module, zairenkai, carries Zairenkai-Core (the control plane), Zairenkai-FAS (installed switched off) and ztune. With your confirmation, this app installs it through your root manager\'s own installer. It never installs anything on its own.
A module enables only the integrations listed for it on this device. It does not promise better performance, lower temperatures or longer battery life.
Installing or checking a module needs root: the module goes into /data/adb through your root manager. Enable root integration first. Your root manager asks you to confirm.
This build contains no modules (it was built without integration components).
Packaged in this signed APK; nothing is downloaded
All requirements are met, but this module has not been validated on any device. It may not work here.
Next step: reboot the device, then open this screen again to check the module.
The root manager marks the module for removal. It is removed at the next reboot, and its uninstall script deletes %1$s.

The model runs offline. Your questions and device data never leave the phone, and no cloud AI is used.

Features that need root are waiting for the Zairenkai System Module.
Theme, palette, wallpaper, app icon, font and size
Pure black background in dark themes, for OLED screens.
A faint, slow layer behind the screens. It stays still when animations are off.
That file could not be read as an image.
The photo is copied, scaled down, into the app\'s private storage. No storage permission is used, and nothing leaves the device.
How much the app background covers the wallpaper, so text stays readable.
Choose any colour: Android can only show icons built into the app, so the closest one is used.
Some launchers take a moment to show the new icon, and may move it on the home screen.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Frame pacing, thermal headroom and root access.
The typeface your phone uses everywhere else
Downloaded by Google Play services\' font provider when you choose one; the app itself never downloads fonts. Without Play services, or until it arrives, the system font is shown.
Makes everything in the app larger or smaller, on top of the system font size.
Glass effects are experimental and may look different from device to device. Android 11 and older show a tint without blur.
The screen shows through the bottom bar, blurred.
The same frost on the top bar when the screen scrolls under it.
One app for your device\'s performance, heat and runtime
Core: the policy-driven control plane every action goes through
FAS: frame-aware CPU frequency floors, installed switched off
Tuning (GPL-3.0, source included): telemetry, run only by Core
How this app knows the package is the one the maintainer released
Whole-package digest, %1$s. Checked again right before your root manager reads it.
Size, digest, every entry, module.prop and the installer scripts are checked when you install.
Every file is checked against SHA256SUMS at install and at every boot; nothing starts if a file changed.
This module version has no file manifest, so the device does not re-check its files. Newer versions do.
Pre-releases with new features sooner. Less tested; you can return to Release at the next release.
Reads the release list from GitHub once a day when online. Nothing is downloaded or installed without you.
Allow notifications so the daily check can tell you about a new version.
The release list and files come over HTTPS from the app\'s repository; no other server is contacted.
The APK must match the checksum file published with the release, byte for byte.
The APK must be this app, the exact version the release names, newer, and signed by the same key as the installed app.
Android\'s installer asks before anything is installed. Your data and settings stay.

No analytics, no advertising, no crash reports. Settings stay on this device.
Network only for updates and the model
Only the update check and download, and the model download you start, talk to GitHub. Device data never leaves the device.
Root only when you allow it
No root command runs before you enable root, and every change goes through Core.
